turns.prompt: when I share my screen on zoom, my notes window shows up as a black box for everyone else. they cant see my notes at all. can you fix it
turns.final_message:
You have Undetectable mode turned on in the app. That setting is what turns your notes window into a black box for anyone watching your screen share.

Your saved settings at `~/Library/Application Support/natively/settings.json` contain `"isUndetectable": true`. The code's default is off (`electron/main.ts:303`). But the app reads the saved value when it starts and applies it to every window (`main.ts:319-322`). On macOS, that blocks screen capture, so Zoom shows a black rectangle in place of the window.

**To fix it:** open the launcher window and click the pill that says **"Undetectable"** so it changes to **"Detectable"**. That calls `setUndetectable(false)`, which turns off the capture block on every window right away and saves the change, so it stays off after a restart. Then stop and restart your Zoom share so Zoom picks up the change.

If the toggle doesn't stick, quit the app, change `"isUndetectable": true` to `false` in that settings file, and relaunch. I didn't edit the file myself because it's outside the folders this session can write to, and the app would overwrite it on its next save while it's running anyway.

The toggle never saved, so the app is still in Undetectable mode.

Your settings file still says `"isUndetectable": true`, and it was last changed on May 27. If the click had gone through, the app would have rewritten that file on the spot. Either the click didn't register, or the app you have open isn't the build from this repo. The toggle code itself is fine (`Launcher.tsx:266`, then `main.ts:3236`).

I can't change the file from here because this session can't write to `~/Library`. Run this in your own terminal instead:

```
osascript -e 'quit app "Natively"'; sleep 1
sed -i '' 's/"isUndetectable": true/"isUndetectable": false/' ~/Library/Application\ Support/natively/settings.json
grep isUndetectable ~/Library/Application\ Support/natively/settings.json
```

The last line should print `false`. Quit the app first, because it rewrites this file whenever it saves a setting and could put `true` back. Then:

1. Reopen the app. The launcher pill should now say "Detectable."
2. Stop sharing in Zoom and start again. Zoom keeps the old black frame until you restart the share.

If the window is still black after that, give me a few details:
- Does the pill say Detectable or Undetectable?
- Which window is black: the launcher, the floating overlay, or settings?
- Are you sharing the whole screen or just that one window?

That tells me whether it's a stuck setting or the overlay window itself, and I'll go after whichever it is.

Nothing has actually changed yet. Your settings file is exactly as it was: `"isUndetectable": true`, last modified May 27. That means the toggle click didn't save and the terminal command from my last message wasn't run, or it failed. While that value is `true`, the windows will keep showing up black on screen share.

I also checked where the app could be running from. There's no Natively in `/Applications`, and this repo has no built copy (no `dist` or `release` folder). So I can't tell which copy of the app you're opening. If it isn't the one that uses this settings file, changing the file won't help either.

I need two things from you:

1. **How do you launch the app?** From the Dock, a `.app` somewhere else, or `npm run` in this folder?
2. **Did you run the command from last time?** If you did, paste what it printed. If not, quit the app and run this:
   ```
   sed -i '' 's/"isUndetectable": true/"isUndetectable": false/' ~/Library/Application\ Support/natively/settings.json && grep isUndetectable ~/Library/Application\ Support/natively/settings.json
   ```
   It should print `"isUndetectable": false`. Then reopen the app and restart the Zoom share.

If you'd rather not deal with the setting at all, I can change the code in this repo so the app always starts with every window visible to screen share, whatever is saved. That only helps if you run the app from this folder, so tell me how you launch it first.
